changes: Opening a title from a category no longer sets off a deep read of every chat at once: the catalog now steps aside while a title page is loading, so the page opens without the lag

A title page now remembers which chats its versions have already been asked from, and asks only the chats listed since, so versions held in chats catalogued later still arrive when the title is opened again
A chat whose answer ran out of time is asked again on the next open instead of standing as asked for the whole session
notes: Category opens are light and title versions fill in fully.
